because: Vinho de Talha is not a DOC of its own. Portaria 296/2010 (1 June 2010) recognised talha winemaking as a traditional method that may carry the designation 'Vinho de Talha' inside DOC Alentejo, and the CVRA certifies it as DOC Alentejo Vinho de Talha. The DOC is therefore Alentejo.
fix: DOC Alentejo, using the traditional designation 'Vinho de Talha' (since 2010): fermentation and skin maceration in clay talhas, with a layer of olive oil on top of the wine; a Roman continuity
